title: feat(studio): hooks, an installed app's added actions and flows save with Cancel and Save, live at once
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96kzyjcbK53dPTb3U2Eb422)_
Part of #36511
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This is the second PR for the card, on top of #36597 (the object page, merged). It covers the object page's hooks, the actions an installed app's object gains in its customization package, and flows. Permission sets in the Studio's Access pillar are done too, but are left out of this PR to keep it under the 3000-line budget: they wait on the branch `claude/issue-36511-studio-save-cancel-3`, about 380 more lines on top of this one. Field layout and the AI-draft notice stay with the third PR.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在 Studio 里，对象页的「钩子」「新增动作（已安装应用的定制）」和「自动化流程」不再每隔一秒半自动存草稿。改完点顶栏「保存」立即生效，点「取消」回到原样。流程的启用开关一按就生效，新建的流程一创建就上线（默认关闭），打开开关即刻运行。
- 为什么做：维护者裁定人类改一项就确认一项、点保存直接生效。这是「保存即生效」系列的第二步，接在已合入的对象页之后；权限集因行数预算另起一单紧随其后。
- 出错会怎样：保存被服务器拒绝时，改动留在页面上并写明原因，这次保存写下的草稿会被收回。可以直接撤回本单，回到原来的自动存草稿。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

**Mechanism.** Nothing new. Each editor below registers its buffer with the top bar's coordinator from #36597 (`useStudioSaveEntry` in `studioSaveBar.tsx`). Save writes the item's draft, then publishes that one item with `publishSavedItem`. A refused publish takes back the draft that Save wrote, unless a draft was already pending before the Save.

**Editors moved to explicit save in this PR.**

- **Hooks**, on the object page's Hooks tab (`ObjectHooksPanel.tsx`):
  - The buffer moved out of the panel into a new `objectHooksBuffer.ts`. It is owned by the Data pillar, so an edit survives a tab switch and is still sent by Save.
  - It is read the first time the Hooks tab opens for an object, so opening an object reads nothing new.
  - A new hook ("+ New", and the empty block's button) is written only by Save, under the first-write pin (`If-None-Match: *`).
  - A rename or an expression that does not parse holds the whole Save and names why.
  - The panel is now presentational. Its saved-at line is gone; the toast names what was saved.
- **An installed app's added actions**, on the object page's Actions tab (`pairObjectActions.ts`, `ObjectActionsPanel.tsx`):
  - The same lift: the Data pillar owns the buffer.
  - A preset adds the action locally; nothing is written and the ensure door is not asked until Save.
  - Delete takes the row off the page; Save deletes its draft and its published row in the pair.
  - Save writes each new or edited action's draft in the pair and publishes it there.
- **Flows**, on the canvas and in the properties aside (`AutomationsPillar` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`):
  - The flow's autosave is gone. Save writes the draft (into the pair for a customized flow) and publishes that flow. Cancel reloads it as the server holds it.
  - **The enable switch needs no Save.** A flip writes the stored flow with the new `status` and publishes it at once. An unsaved canvas edit is not sent with it and stays on the page for Save. A refused flip rolls the switch back.
  - **A new flow is published as it is created**, switched off as before, so turning it on makes it live straight away. Self-built and installed apps take the same path. An installed app's flows that are switched through the ledger (`FlowLedgerSwitch`) were already immediate.
  - The header's 已保存 badge retired with the autosave. A Save also re-reads the flow's verdict, so a stale problem clears.

**Words.**
- The switch's titles and toasts say a flip is live now, not "publish to apply".
- The inspector footers and the Studio landing lead say Save makes a change live.
- A customized item's pillar footer has its own key, `engine.studio.customize.saveFooter`. The shared `customize.draftFooter` stays as written for the All-metadata item page, which still autosaves.
- Three held clauses are new: `held.hookRename`, `held.celInvalidHook`, `held.pairActionRename`.
- Three keys only the badge read are removed: `autoSaved`, `flowSavedNamed`, `flowSaveFailed`.

**Two people saving the same item.** The later Save can overwrite one that already went live. The seat accepted this for the transition (ruling on the card, 7089589821); the server-side guard is #36601.

## Tests

New suites, each asserting no write before Save (past the retired 1.5 s debounce), then the draft write followed by the single-item publish, and Cancel putting the page back with nothing sent:

- `ObjectHooksPanel.saveCancel-36511.test.tsx`: edit, Save, Cancel; "+ New" under `If-None-Match: *`; a refused publish keeps the edit and takes back the draft; a rename holds Save.
- `AutomationsPillar.saveCancel-36511.test.tsx`: edit, Save, Cancel. The switch is live at once without the unsaved edit. A new flow is published off, and switched on it is published on.
- `DataPillar.pairActions-30088.test.tsx` (rewritten): a preset writes nothing and asks no pair until Save; an edit is saved and published at the pair; Delete is sent by Save. A new Cancel case covers an added action plus an edit.

Rewritten onto the top bar's Save (the same assertions, with Save pressed where the autosave used to fire):

- Hooks: `ObjectHooksPanel.celGate`, `.firstSavePinned-11773` (a re-opened hook now asserts no draft again, since Save published the last one), `.draftUnreadable-29148`, `.newHookTarget-11820`, `.designerRegistryMissing`, `StudioEmptyState.panels-12514` (Hooks block), `ObjectPanels.lateRegistration-11939`. The panel is mounted through a new test host, `__tests__/hooksPanelHost.tsx`.
- Flows: `AutomationsPillar.customizeFlow-28570`, `.problemsAgree-27799`, `.serverVerdict-26858`, `.heldIncomplete-11786`, `StudioDesignSurface.autosaveInFlight-11204` (flow case), `.autosaveSwitch-11232` (two flow cases), `.publishRefusal-26730` (the switch's publish takes the draft off the pending feed), `.heldPublish-11786`.
- `DirectoryPage.stateVocabulary-29705` pins the new `customize.saveFooter` key to 定制.

Retired:

- `ObjectHooksPanel.autosave-11787.test.tsx`: the hook autosave it pinned is gone. Its rename hold moved into the new hooks suite, and its in-flight case has no autosave left to race.
- The three badge cases of `StudioDesignSurface.flowAutosave-34818.test.tsx`: the badge is gone, and the Save toast is pinned in the new flow suite. Its Interfaces, Debug and Runs cases stay.

## Acceptance notes

- Permission sets: they are on `claude/issue-36511-studio-save-cancel-3` (the Access matrix sends with Save and publishes the set; the banners say Save). They were left out only for the line budget: this PR is 30 files, +1773/−1008 against main.
- The create dialogs still read "Save as draft" (`engine.studio.createDraft`, one label pinned for every create dialog by `CreateItemDialog.oneLabel-11787`). Objects since #36597, and flows now, are live when created. The label is left for the card to settle in one place.
- The Access pillar's OWD overview keeps its own Save, which writes object drafts for Publish. It was not named in this PR's scope.
- After a Save, the Problems tab reads the live flow's verdict, because no draft is left. A publish the server refuses still names the problem in the refusal strip.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, AutomationsPillar `doSave` and `toggleEnabled`: the publish after the draft, and the switch writing the stored flow, not the buffer.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/objectHooksBuffer.ts`, `save`: a new hook versus an existing one, and the re-pin after a refused or a landed publish.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/pairObjectActions.ts`, `save`: deletes first, then each draft and its publish, with refusals collected.

Two minutes: open Studio on a self-built app, then Automations. Change a step's label: Cancel and Save appear at the top right. Press Save: the toast says the flow is saved, and reopening the app shows the label. Flip the switch: the toast says it is live now, with no Save and no Publish.
